description: This file defines the MapFieldCodec class, a serializer/deserializer for MapField<TKey, TValue> objects in the Orleans serialization framework. It handles reading and writing map fields with key-value pairs, supporting reference management and wire protocol handling.

classes.name: MapFieldCodec`2
classes.description: A sealed generic class implementing IFieldCodec for MapField objects with key and value types TKey and TValue, responsible for serializing and deserializing map data.

methods.name: MapFieldCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing key and value codecs, unwrapping services if needed.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a MapField<TKey, TValue> object into a buffer using a key/value encoding protocol.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from a reader into a MapField<TKey, TValue> object, handling references and wire protocol.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MapField<TKey, TValue> instance and records it in the serialization session.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Throws an exception if the declared length exceeds input length.

methods.name: ThrowLengthFieldMissing
methods.description: Throws an exception if the length field of the serialized MapField is missing.
